tagline: Providing financing and capital to the long-term healthcare industry
hero_kpi_rationale: No distinct wow factor identified. Rental income is the primary driver of the business model as a healthcare-focused real estate investment trust, representing the majority of recurring revenues.

kpis.name: Rental Income
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from leases on healthcare real estate properties.
kpis.description: Rental income increased due to improved collections and new leases signed.
kpis.signal: Sustained growth driven by long-term leases.

kpis.name: Interest Income
kpis.explanation: Revenue from real estate loans provided to healthcare facility operators.
kpis.description: Moderate growth linked to new loans and stable interest rates.
kpis.signal: Stable secondary source of recurring revenue.

kpis.name: Real Estate Acquisitions
kpis.explanation: Amount invested in acquiring new healthcare real estate properties.
kpis.description: The acquisition of 45 facilities in the United Kingdom and Jersey significantly increased acquisition spending.
kpis.signal: Significant expansion in 2025, particularly in the United Kingdom.

kpis.name: Loan Placements Net
kpis.explanation: Net amount of new loans issued, after deducting repayments.
kpis.description: Fewer new loans issued in 2025, offset by repayments of existing loans.
kpis.signal: Sharp decline in new lending in 2025.

kpis.name: Impairment Loss
kpis.explanation: Amount of accounting impairments on real estate properties deemed less valuable.
kpis.description: Loss of $22.6M on 8 facilities in 2025, compared to $23.8M on 14 in 2024.

kpis.name: Dividends Paid

kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale. Indicateur clé pour les investisseurs orientés revenus.
kpis.description: 5-year history of declared dividends per share (2021-2025).

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel du cash redistribué aux actionnaires : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions (treasury stock).
kpis.description: For 2025: cumulative dividends + share buybacks in billions USD.

kpis.explanation: Part du bénéfice net redistribuée en dividendes. Au-dessus de 80 % indique un dividende potentiellement non-soutenable.
kpis.description: Dividends / net income for 2025 (based on net income attributable to shareholders).

kpis.signal: Total revenue of $1.19 Bn in the last fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Net Income

kpis.signal: Net income of $0.59 Bn in the last fiscal year (FY2025).

risks.title: Operator Financial Distress
risks.score_rationale: Risk cited in the opening section of risk factors with strong language ('material adverse effect'). 20 operators are on cash basis revenue recognition, representing nearly 20% of total revenues. Maplewood and LaVie situations illustrate ongoing deterioration. Industrial category is heavily weighted here.

risks.title: Persistent Labor Shortage
risks.score_rationale: Identified as a major challenge since the pandemic, with direct impact on operator costs and profitability. Connection to inflation and immigration policy strengthens the intensity. Central to management's narrative.

risks.title: Inflationary Pressure and Rising Costs
risks.score_rationale: Explicit language on negative impact of inflation and global tariffs. Risk repeated across multiple paragraphs and linked to operators' ability to pay. Persistent unfavorable macroeconomic backdrop.

risks.title: Regulatory and Public Reimbursement Uncertainty
risks.score_rationale: Multiple references to uncertainties around Medicaid, Medicare, and OBBBA. Mention of indirect effects potentially reducing funding. Strategic positioning in the document with warnings on material impacts.

risks.title: Concentration Risk with Key Operators
risks.score_rationale: Maplewood loan represents 18.1% of total loans. Complex restructuring involving PIK and rent deferrals, indicating significant exposure. Risk concentrated on a small number of assets.

risks.title: Restructurings and Deferred Rent
risks.score_rationale: Maplewood case featuring rent deferrals, deferred payments and PIK. Obligation to pay annual minimum, but risk of default on these payments. Key indicator of credit stress.

risks.title: Sensitive International Exposure
risks.score_rationale: Presence in UK, Canada, and Jersey noted, with implicit regulatory and FX risk. Less developed than domestic risks, but new Canadian entry signals risky expansion.
